card: One Google sign-in call across web and native apps.
title: Capacitor Auth Manager for sign-in
intro: Capacitor Auth Manager gives app makers one Google sign-in call across web, Android and iOS. The current provider scope is narrow and stated plainly.

sections.heading: What does the package handle?
sections.body: The package gives web, Android and iOS apps a shared Google sign-in call.

sections.heading: Does it need Firebase?
sections.body: Firebase is not a required dependency for that call.

sections.heading: Which providers work in version 3.x?
sections.body: Google is the enabled provider in the 3.x line. That is the scope today.

sections.heading: Where does Capacitor Auth Manager fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell is an app you sign in to. This package is for the people building app sign-in, with Google as its current provider.
